candidate_selection: Training log-correlation only; no test-based rescue or shape/orientation refit.
mechanism_conclusion: A sharp illumination edge produces a directional streak with unchanged smooth-sphere or core-shell morphology. Smoothing suppresses the streak.
actual_data_conclusion: The offset-Gaussian family improves both radial-band folds in each of the two fixed-geometry frames. Edge-family gains are mixed. This does not identify the real probe or streak source, exclude liquid-jet background, or establish single-hit purity.
workflow_conclusion: Projected field-amplitude multiplication is direct. Full complex-plane IFFT-mask-CZT and Fourier convolution are equivalent alternatives. The measured additional IFFT is a 2D tail cost, not an end-to-end 3D-CZT comparison.
